paper_title: Before Generation, Align it! A Novel and Effective Strategy for   Mitigating Hallucinations in Text-to-SQL Generation
caption: Results of different logical synthesis modules on BIRD-dev.
model_annotation: This chart illustrates the execution accuracy of two SQL generation methods, NatSQL and TA-SQL, across different levels of difficulty, as well as their total accuracy. The horizontal axis lists the categories: Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total, while the vertical axis represents Execution Accuracy, labeled and scaled linearly from 20 to 60 with a tick interval of 10. The chart features grouped bars, with each group containing two bars representing NatSQL (light blue) and TA-SQL (dark blue), as indicated by the legend. The Simple category has NatSQL at approximately 60.21 and TA-SQL at 63.14, Moderate has NatSQL at 39.64 and TA-SQL at 48.60, Challenging has NatSQL at 32.32 and TA-SQL at 36.11, and Total has NatSQL at 51.35 and TA-SQL at 56.19. The bars are grouped by category, with TA-SQL consistently having a higher value than NatSQL within each category. The chart does not display any specific sorting or visual emphasis on the bars beyond the color distinction between the two methods.
